title: The rest stop
logline: Wednesday. I-5 south. A rest stop. Wood asleep in the Legacy with the seat back, the sketchbook on his chest, open to the dock. A truck's shadow crosses him. Four panels of a man asleep.

panels.composition: A rest stop off I-5, trucks. The Legacy. WOOD asleep in the driver's seat, reclined, the sketchbook open on his chest.

characters.pose: asleep, the sketchbook on his chest

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a faded green station wagon at a highway rest stop among trucks with a thin man asleep in the reclined driver's seat and a sketchbook open on his chest

panels.composition: The open page on his chest, rising and falling: the dock. Her head on his shoulder. The one panel.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, close-up of an open sketchbook on a sleeping man's chest showing a small ink drawing of two figures on a dock at night

panels.composition: A truck's shadow crossing the car, the page, his face. Then light again.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a truck's shadow sliding across a station wagon and a sleeping man's face, then bright light returning, no words

panels.composition: Still asleep. The page. The empty passenger seat. Four hundred miles from the dog. Two hundred to go.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a thin man asleep in a car at a rest stop with an open sketchbook on his chest and an empty passenger seat, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Asleep with the dock on his chest. A truck's shadow.
